# ThreeUI ModernToggle

Source: https://github.com/MengTo/threeui/tree/main/src/shaders/skeuomorphic-toggle
Retrieved 2026-10-07 through the GitHub contents API. Original MIT license is retained in LICENSE.

FireWatch changes: optional controlled checked/disabled props, onChange outside a state updater, and scoped game CSS overrides for a compact orange toggle. No Three.js dependency is added. Originkit is a visual reference only; no authenticated component source was obtained or copied.
